customers.evidence: Focus on the user and all else will follow.

employees.evidence: We put great stock in our employees

dei.evidence: energetic, passionate people from diverse backgrounds

community.evidence: Our company was founded in California, but our mission is to facilitate access to information for the entire world

integrity.evidence: We never manipulate rankings to put our partners higher in our search results

innovation.evidence: Through innovation and iteration, we aim to take things that work well and improve upon them in unexpected ways.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with frequent 'we believe', 'we aim' and 'we hope' hedging. Users come first, followed by search quality and speed; employees and the business model appear later. Commitments are framed as principles rather than measurable pledges. Distinctive wording includes 'do one thing really, really well' and 'you can hold us to that.'
